body.message:
Got it, so you're looking at a 1-month stay from April 1st in the Aykon City 2BR. The rate is AED 7,900/month, all-inclusive covering water, electricity, and internet.

To secure the unit, you'd need to pay the first and last month as a reservation deposit, plus a refundable damage deposit of AED 5,000.

Want to go ahead, or would you like to arrange a viewing first?
